I exited the pay screen and scanned my dog's QR code, to have a pop up show that said I couldn't access my information via Crumb as it wasn't the paid edition. Given that it is only £5 a month, I decided to give it a try and signed up. Payment went immediately and I then scanned his QR code again, for it to display my details (has a ring button but not my phone number ('for security', but DOES show my address when scanned- I'm not sure this is secure- I'd rather it showed my number than my address, but preferably neither!). Overall, I do think it offers a service that could prove invaluable if ever needed, but I don't appreciate being told that you don't need a subscription, only to have to pay to be alerted to my pup's location, should the worst happen. Very disappointing and something to bare in mind for those of you wanting a free service.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: I ordered 2 tags as they were…
review: I ordered 2 tags as they were advertised as free on FB they arrived quickly and I set them up but went to activate them and they put me through to PayPal at £6,95 a month and yet they were advertised as free ! Can’t speak to anyone so I don’t know if they’re activated if I don’t pay

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: Very confusing for old people
review: Very  confusing as I am 75 and normally work on my desktop  computer and I don't understand the mobile.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: Nice tag, bad surprise subscription
review: The free tag is nicely designed, but springing a $60 annual subscription on me after collecting all that personal info was not well received.  Better to have the price before making us enter all that.  If it's worth the price, we'll pay it.  If not, you've just irritated a potential customer.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: it was very easy to apply for the…
review: it was very easy to apply for the 'free' (pay only p&p - at this stage), the tags arrived within 2 days.  It was also very easy to set up my dog's details, med conditions, allergies etc.  However right at the end of this process the monthly cost was mentioned - I was then annoyed that this tag is advertised as free - it really isn't.  I have trawled through the online info and found no mention of costs, this is misleading.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: I'm beyond disappointed with my Crumb…
review: I'm beyond disappointed with my Crumb pet ID tag. I've reached out to their customer support countless times, even trying to contact them through Facebook, but I've been completely ignored.To make matters worse, the print on the tag is already wearing off after only two weeks!  And the biggest issue? I can't even update my dog's information on their website – it keeps saying she's male, even though I've tried to correct it multiple times. This was my main reason for contacting them in the first place!It's such a shame because the idea behind the tag is fantastic, but the execution is terrible. Honestly, why don't they use a more durable material or seal the print with something like rubber to prevent this? It feels like a basic design flaw.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: No transparency about subscription costs
review: I had a number of messages from a number of people at crumb. They all gave conflicting information, specifically about the monthly cost. I was even offered a discount which still cost more than the amount on the website. The free trial is irrelevant as the tag arrived at the end of the two weeks, I reguested cancellation of the auto renew but this clearly hasn’t been done as they have scheduled two payments to come out of my account totalling nearly £50, 3 days after receiving the tag. However I am sure this is an admin error and they will do the right thing and honour my wishes. Great idea but executed very badly. UPDATE: Crumb have refunded my subscription costs and I am happy with the resolution.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: This would have warranted 5 stars
review: This would have warranted 5 stars. Sienna's tag arrived swiftly and works well. I liked being able to include her photo at startup and the whole process is easy, quick and hassle free. Unfortunately. (This might be me getting it wrong, I might have missed the notification) before you can activate, you have to choose your payment option! £4.99pm just to register the tag. Then, it offers a vet on call for a further c£4.99. These are recurring monthly payments and you can't register without a monthly fee. ( or an annual fee for small discount.) I prefer to have the information about cost ahead of ordering. You need transparency from the off. Otherwise, an excellent idea.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: It’s asking to sign up for a plan but…
review: It’s asking to sign up for a plan but advertisement states it’s free so it’s misleading

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: Marketing needs to be transparent…
review: The product is fine but your marketing could have been transparent ie, activating the tag comes with a cost. What percentage of tags, which you ve posted, have been activated? If it is significant, think about the waste! Also, your site notes ‘upgrade to premium’, when activating: There is no other choice apart from not activating the tag.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: Not enough info about Free Service.
review: Updated—Following my original review below, I was contacted by Crumb and given details of how to access the Free  service for the tags. They also refunded my postage. To give a 4 star  and upgrade to premium they would need to allow international phone codes to be entered as we often take the dogs out of the UK.Like other people I thought there was a basic level rather than having to upgrade. Surely an upgrade means that there is also a basic level? Also when putting in pet details, colour options were very basic and even included green! Will continue just using my basic metal tags.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: I was somewhat mistaken by this company…
review: I was somewhat mistaken by this company they seem to be genuine but just a bit naive about how to sell there product. I cannot praise them enough for correcting what was maybe my error. But they were up front honest and very genuine so good luck in the future but this product is currently not for me. Thank you Nick for you kindness and explanation

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: Received the tag quickly and I think…
review: Received the tag quickly and I think its a great idea - I did agree to the £4.95 monthly cost but then had a change of heart as can do better elsewhere - when I opted to cancel subscription it straight away gave me a discount - not good practice - please be upfront with costs

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: Tag came in a couple of days but here's…
review: Tag came in a couple of days but here's the catch. You have to pay £4.95 a month to activate the tag otherwise it's useless. As someone else said, better to pay a tracker subscription and know yourself exactly where your pet is. Also bear in mind that if you are in the UK this is an American company.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: It's ok but a little discerning as to…
review: It's ok but a little discerning as to how it works free tags but cost a month not happy about that could have got air tags

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: There is nothing ‘free’ about this offer.
review: You are enticed to pay £3 postage for a tag.  I was under the impression it was free.  £4.95 per month to then ‘activate’ it… no mention of this prior to ordering his ‘free offer’.  It is very misleading… Have to say I have received a response from Crumb and a postage refund, so that is very good customer service and that deserves 5 stars.  Need to let customers know in advance about monthly charge then they won’t feel like they have been misled.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: Initially signed up for "free" tags
review: Initially signed up for "free" tags,  only to find out there was a fee charged,  managed to find a customer number and reduced the fee. However 2 months in, I have now received txt and email to say tags are no longer active, and they have failed to collect recent recurring fee. Given this has previously gone from my account on 4th of month, I fail to see how, as it isn't yet that.  I followed the link sent to reactivate account and the cost has returned to previous high cost.  So be aware, if the company fail to collect payment, through no fault of your own, nothing has changed, money in account, they cancel your tags immediately.  No such thing as Free.  As originally advertised.  Very very poor.  Spend the money on conventional engraved tags

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: Avoid crumb
review: Massive spamming of emails avoid. Dodgy upgrade sales approach.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: Tag is Free....but Subscription Based
review: This is a great idea except that in order for the information to be viewable to anyone, the owner must pay for a monthly subscription. This is not clear upfront. It's why the tags have been free, the money is in the subscription. This is the same principal as a microchip, but in the end is more expensive and the tags can be lost. Get your pet microchiped instead

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: Misleading wording for free account
review: The sign up process suggests that you can pay for postage to get the tag and free profile. However, when you receive the tag and start creating the profile you are unable to "Activate" the tag unless you agree to pay a monthly subscription. There are no other options on the activation page to just continue with a free profile. If you go back to your dashboard, it will appear that the profile is not usable until you activate it. This is indicated by the washed out colours on the icons, along with the same colours for the paid-for features, implying they are not active. If you scan the physical tag (not the QR code on the piece of paper included), it will show the limited pet profile with basic contact info (so it doesn't actually require activation to use). The "activate" wording in this instance is misleading. After 30 minutes or more of refusing to click activate, I received an email making out that the Co-founder had personally given me an offer code and forwarded this to another co-founder to contact me. Most likely automatically generated and no direct communication from co-founders. All wording encouraged a sale by using phrases such as "I don't know how long this discount code will be active for...". Horrible tactics.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: Pet tag
review: Bought the pet tag, not realising there was a monthly fee that applied. You can't set it up without paying the fee. Thinking I had missed this info somewhere, I went back and re read everything. Absolutely no mention of a monthly fee anywhere very misleading!!

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: Probably should have known that you…
review: Probably should have known that you don’t get anything for free. First time I saw anything about a monthly subscription was when I got to the point where you activate the tag. Seems pointless paying monthly for another tag as we already have the traditional type with name and phone number as well as having a chip. Judging by the number of people posting they got a free replacement when they lost one they can’t be that robust.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: Unhelpful at point of cancellation.
review: After trialling crumb for two months I didn't find that I was getting value for money and wanted to cancel. My first three requests went undetected, or maybe ignored, by Crumb. Bow I finally have contact with them I've had two emails trying to persuade me to stay anf they've not yet complied with my request to cancel. I don't mind having wasted £20 as I wanted to trial the service, however I do take issue with them being difficult when I've concluded that Crumb is not for me.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: DISGRACEFUL ACTION BY THIS COMPANY
review: These people are doing underhanded advertising regarding this free tag.it's not free at all and not clearly explained. BE AWARE NOT AS GREAT AS YOU FIRST THINK

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: The company have gone a long way to rectify things
review: I have decided to edit my feedback due to this company contacting me and their attempt to make things right.  This doesn't mean that my experience wasn't bad, but it means they have gone a long way to rectify it.  I am hoping that perhaps they will look to trying to stop this kind of thing happening in the future to other unsuspecting people as it a horrid feeling to panic and worry about money when the country is in this economic mess.  No matter what age we are.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.
title: First impression was good but I was very wrong!
review: First impression was good and the £3 for the tag seemed great value. Little did I know I had signed up to a monthly subscription of £9.99! Which I cannot afford and did not want/agree to. Is have been on the website trying to cancel this subscription but this is impossible and frustrating, despite following the guidance.Awaiting a reply from crumb. I feel mislead and unhappy.

description:
HI, WE'RE FUNNYFUZZY.
We believe having them in our life is the most wonderful journey.

We want to enjoy every moment with them.

That's how we started, to make this journey delightful and memorable.


MAKE IT SIMPLE
Aren’t we all want to spend more time with them, use the products that make them feel comfortable, we wish that we could give everything to them.

So we make it simple, we put all the things into one: multi-functional leashes, all-purpose harnesses...all basic on simple and practical principles with our years of experience in the pet product industry.


DESIGN AESTHETIC
Not only do we value practicality, but we also hold on to our aesthetic value.

The beautiful design could evoke your inner emotions, which your pet could be connected with. That makes our product more than an object.


EXCELLENT QUALITY
Quality is important for us. It shows our responsibility and reliability to our pets.

Therefore, we set our manufacturing standard to a high level, that’s how we do as an owner, a parent, a good friend.


LOVE MORE
Are you wondering what goes through their little minds?
Although we don’t speak dog language, we could show affection through our actions.There are many ways to show them, and there is more than one way to love them.
title: two seater sofa cover set…
review: We ordered a two seater sofa cover set which is great. It is made of a lovely quality material and waterproof and scratch proof which has really helped to protect our velvet sofa! The items arrived a little slower than expected but it was over the festive period so I don't really think that's a negative.

review: Product was competitively priced however the communication by the delivery company was awful and my requests for an update on when the delivery would be from Trusty Pet Supplies went unanswered. review: Trusty pets have been brilliant again, goods delivered on time, I’ve had delivered 2 x 20kg bags of bird seed but again 1 of the boxes was damaged, I guess not  the fault of Trusty Pets, having said that I have suggested that Trusty Pets supply this type of order in smaller boxes which would be better.

title: Delivered within a few days and left…
review: Delivered within a few days and left just inside our garage as requested - good service.We order quite large supplies of peanuts etc which are heavy for us to move around and the packaging tends to break. We can order multiple bags of course but there is no point if these are all loaded into one cardboard box. Perhaps the ordering service could provide for a maximum parcel weight?

description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.

review: Good website makes for easy ordering.  Would like more options for boneless minces as current ones are quite restrictive and boneless chunks are expensive.My main issue was with delivery - it was ordered for Friday and actually arrived on Thursday, and the DPD driver doesn't follow instructions on where to leave it. He doesn't even ring the doorbell, but just dumps it on the pavement outside the front door, from where it could easily be stolen.

description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.
title: Competitive prices for dry cat food
review: Competitive price for dry cat food. What should have been a 5% discount was incorrectly given as £5, but this was politely and promptly corrected when I emailed the company.Have just unsubscribed from their marketing emails as they were much too frequent.

description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.
title: Selected as a Family Business
review: Easy to order/set up account, immediate discount for large spend (not here's a voucher for your NEXT order).  Kept in the loop with confirmation/processing/delivery (DPD bang on time!!!!)Ordered early evening Wed  Delivered Fri morning 17/2/23.  In my book that's next day & free delivery.Only hitch was 1 of 2 boxed suet pellets - either needed to be bagged@boxed OR tape sealed all the way round the bottom of box not just outside flaps = slight/messy spillage.However, small blip only so would have judged 4.5☆ had that been available.  Have today recommended TRUSTY PET SUPPLIES to my best friend.

description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.
title: All arrived on time and mostly frozen
review: All arrived on time and mostly frozen, some defrosted at the edges which is not a problem. They sell all the makes we like to purchase and use DPD for delivery who is our preferred courier. Only negative comment is that there was not enough packaging to fill spaces at top of box which was therefore quite damaged. Fortunately contents were ok.

description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.
title: Almost a 5
review: It would have been a five, I payed for next day delivery and it was bang on, but the plastic bag with the nuts in had burst in transit. When the van driver pulled it out a good two handfuls went on to the road, I swept them on to our pathway but some had been crushed by the passing cars,the birds still ate them but the worry was, loads of squashed birds.

description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.
title: Good prices and fast delivery
review: Once again good prices and fast delivery. The only downside was that 12kg of calciworms were packed into the same box as 13kg of suet balls. This was clearly too heavy for the box which had split. The delivery company also left the box in my porch (as instructed) but it was so big that I couldn’t actually get into my porch and when I tried to climb over it the box split further. May be better to package separately in future.

description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.

review: Regular and reliable dog food deliveries. Really happy and would recommend. Had good customer service in the past although on the last delivery I called because the dog food wasn't sealed airtight and I also wanted to adjust the delivery frequency (to make it more often) but nobody has responded to my message. Not a big deal on this occasion but that's why I didn't give a 5 star rating.

review: Usually an excellent, fast delivery but this time my Yak chews came in a bag not the usual box. As they are brittle, they were damaged with bits chipped off them 😔. The dogs still love them but would recommend sticking to boxing them in future please! At £70 a box I would like them to be perfect 😀

description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.
title: Great selection of raw DIY food and…
review: Great selection of raw DIY food and really fast delivery from order. But a couple of times I have ordered Turkey neck chunks and have received full turkey necks. I only have small dogs so cutting them into pieces is not easy! Not sure if this is Premium raws issue as it says CHUNKS on the label but isn’t.

description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.
title: I recently put my dog on a raw food…
review: I recently put my dog on a raw food diet and ordered almost 20kg of meat chunks. Although it's probably my fault for not realising, the meat arrived already frozen, which meant I had to spend the next few hours cutting through frozen meat before I could place everything in the freezer. Was a nightmare! Might be best to make it very clear that raw food will arrive in frozen state.

review: Only issue was as a new customer I attempted to create an account online. I filled out every available box with my details, but it wouldn't accept until I provided a new password for the account. Unfortunately they were totally unhelpfully and disinterested, stating that side of things is nothing to do with them and it would be the warehouse that controlled the website.

title: Slow delivery & poor communication
review: Delivery has slowed down & communication is non existent.I have sent an email and no response.

description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.

review: Fantastic delivery time but this is the third successive order where the box has not been securely taped and was gaping open in delivery. Also, VAT shown on receipt for delivery to Channel Islands address so not applicable. Advised of this but no response to date!

description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.

The products were all present and at least it has now arrived so that is an improvement on my previous supplier!

description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.

review: Super efficient service. The product arrived within 36 hours of ordering. description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.

description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.

description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.

review: I have always been impressed by the speedy delivery service. I was eventually phoned but by then it was too late.  I subsequently cancelled the subscription and then renewed it and all was then well.  I just wish I could have had a speedier response in the first instance.

title: Delivery was quick as usual for raw dog…
review: Delivery was quick as usual for raw dog food but there was not enough ice packs or packing to 1)stop the defrosting 2)stop the loose boxes being thrown around inside. As a result there was blood over everything and a few tears from wet boxes. I passed this onto customer service, they asked for photos which I had none as I was keen to put things in the freezer and clean blood off all the boxes, my kitchen and myself. They've ignored me ever since. I only suggested to provide 1 more ice pack perhaps during the heatwave and a simple “thanks for your feedback” would have sufficed. The service itself is great but it seems from what I've seen on Google reviews and my own experience, the good service stalls once customer service is involved ironically.

review: In the past I've always had a very good service with Trusty Pet Supplies. In this order I left a note at the checkout to politely ask if they could make sure that the box my items was packed in was in a strong box, and that the bird seed inside was packaged in strong bags, as a few times these have arrived damaged and broken. As the items I ordered were very heavy, I thought this made sense.When the delivery arrived, not only had one of the parcels had to be taped up by DPD because it had broken so badly, but one of the big bags inside had split, causing everything to spill out into the box inside.

title: Disappointed with this order -flimsy packaging.
review: Normally I give Trusty Pets a FIVE STAR review for the packaging and delivery of my Order of Dried Mealworms, HOWEVER this time my order was damaged. Although I cannot fault the Delivery Service...my order arrived VERY speedily and for that I am very grateful...Trusty Pets are so reliable on this issue... BUT I think some attention must be given to the strength of the plastic bag in which the dried mealworms arrived. The bag had split wide open inside the box and the mealworms were no longer in the plastic bag, but loose in the box and they manged to get into every small cranny and fold in the cardboard packaging . It took me AGES to extricate them all and a lot broke up, as they are so fragile if handled. Normally I just pour the contents of the plastic bag straight into the large container in which I keep the mealworms. Not possible this time so rather frustrated. Please can you put them in a stronger bag in the box? Thank you.

description:
In 2008 our founder Henrietta started making food from scratch at her kitchen table in London for her Border Terrier Lily. All because she really, really loved her. That love for our pets started Lily’s Kitchen and still keeps us going today. 
Pets are family and they deserve proper food
But what is proper food?  Proper food means nutritionally complete recipes made by experts, labelled honestly, using ethically sourced natural ingredients. No meat meal, no additives and no cheap fillers. Just fresh meat, delicious veg, and herbs and botanicals that support your dogs’ and cats’ health so they can concentrate on sitting on laps, shoulders and heads, demanding walkies, 6am breakfasts and knocking things over with their tails ‘by accident’ – or so they claim.
For people, pets and the planet
We’re a certified BCorp. That means we believe in using business as a force for good. Here are a few of our guiding values:
Supporting charities
In the last 6 months we’ve donated over 28,000 meals to dog and cat shelters and we’re not stopping there. We’re always working on ways we can partner with charities of all sizes to help in any way we can, be it fundraising, donations or rolling up our sleeves and volunteering our own time.
Minimising our pawprint on the planet
From the way we work to improve our packaging (which is nearly all compostable or recyclable) to the cleaning products we choose for our office. Every decision has the planet at it’s core.
Being a BCorp and staying a BCorp
We are the founding UK BCorporation and every three years we re-certify by evidencing meeting the highest standards of verified social and environmental performance, public transparency and legal accountability to balance profit and purpose.

title: Great food but disapprove of Vegan option
review: Great food, both dogs love it. Lots of choice of flavours in both wet and dry food. Neither dog would touch the new Vegan choice though (which was picked up by mistake) and I can’t understand why this is being produced or advocated for. Dogs are omnivorous, but nonetheless they won’t get all the nutrients they need from plants alone. I advocate for humans choosing a vegan diet for themselves, but we shouldn’t be inflicting this on our animals. It’s dangerous to encourage this purchasing behaviour from shoppers and not in the interest of the health of dogs.

title: Very affordable and sustainable option
review: Really appreciate that it's a UK-based company which supports LGBTQ+ NGOs. One of the most affordable (cost-wise) amongst healthier and sustainable cat foods. Other than that, I have only positive things to say.

Pets are family and they deserve proper food
But what is proper food?  Proper food means nutritionally complete recipes made by experts, labelled honestly, using ethically sourced natural ingredients. No meat meal, no additives and no cheap fillers. Just fresh meat, delicious veg, and herbs and botanicals that support your dogs’ and cats’ health so they can concentrate on sitting on laps, shoulders and heads, demanding walkies, 6am breakfasts and knocking things over with their tails ‘by accident’ – or so they claim.
For people, pets and the planet
We’re a certified BCorp. That means we believe in using business as a force for good. Here are a few of our guiding values:
Supporting charities
In the last 6 months we’ve donated over 28,000 meals to dog and cat shelters and we’re not stopping there. We’re always working on ways we can partner with charities of all sizes to help in any way we can, be it fundraising, donations or rolling up our sleeves and volunteering our own time.
Minimising our pawprint on the planet
From the way we work to improve our packaging (which is nearly all compostable or recyclable) to the cleaning products we choose for our office. Every decision has the planet at it’s core.
Being a BCorp and staying a BCorp
We are the founding UK BCorporation and every three years we re-certify by evidencing meeting the highest standards of verified social and environmental performance, public transparency and legal accountability to balance profit and purpose.

title: Was once the best -but lately the…
review: Was once the best -but lately the quality of the product has deteriorated - the latest tins we have bought are top filled with jelly - our dogs will not eat this slop and we have to scoop it out before serving. Previously you never found jelly infill (i.e. water) in the tins, it is a new phenomena. I hope this drop in quality is just a temporary and accidental. Shame as they were good, and now we may need to find a new source of decent tinned dog food.Based on the response - thank you for your answer. When we open the next tin we will image the jelly and send the batch number. UPDATE despite providing images to Lily's Kitchen clearly showing excessive amounts of jelly in the tins, they just rejected my complaint claiming that it was normal and nothing is wrong. Pity, as at least I would have expected a commitment to investigate that batch. Having a tin with jelly at the base, sides and top is not normal, and to state that it is OK is not an acceptable response.

title: Recipe has cheapened and changed for the worst. My 10yr old pointer had been on Lily’s…
review: My 10yr old pointer had been on Lily’s kitchen since a puppy. Lilys kitchen was bought out by Nestle Purina in 2021. I stuck with it, but started to notice a change in the smell and appearance of the food around 2022/2023 and then noticed a decline in my dogs condition and coat. She got patchy fur and a dull coat and just seemed off. At first I put it down to a number age related factors before switching her food to Natures Menu this year 2024 and she’s improved so much. Lilys kitchen has definitely changed & cheapened and was actually making my dogs sick. Both my 10yr old and 2yr old dogs are shiny and back to best since I changed. I’ll never buy it again.

title: Lily's Kitchen offers quality food, however, too expensive.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Fantastic
review: Reliable, excellent prices plus offers, prompt delivery, respect our property, courteous, helpful especially if box is heavy, follow instructions exactly. Nothing is ever too much trouble.Have relied on Garden Bird for many years now, and will continue to do so.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: It’s good stuff and the birds enjoy the…
review: It’s good stuff and the birds enjoy the variety of  seeds.  My garden has lots of different birds and even a red squirrel chasing me for more seeds.  The suet chips are always popular too, especially with blackbirds who run to me every time I go near the garage to get some more seed out..

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Usual Excellent Service
review: The website is clear, helpful and easy to navigate.  Prices are competitive for a varied selection of seeds, nuts etc.Delivery fast and it arrives when they say it will.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: A Comprehensive Website
review: A comprehensive website, easy to search with full details of product ingredients, including information on which variety of birds that will be tracked to the food. Excellent array of items, very good prices, and exciting special deals. Delivery is fast, and packaging is recyclable.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: I wanted a Christmas present for my…
review: I wanted a Christmas present for my husband i couldnt get what i wanted and found out with only three days to go, i looked on the internet and saw Garden Birds, i placed my order on Sunday 22 Dec. Then took a photo of what I had ordered to show my beloved on Christmas DayNeedn’t have bothered it was all delivered Christmas Eve!Wow!!We live on an Island, so deliverys take longer sometimes. Garden Birds saved the day. I would give them a million stars. Sincere thanks to all concerned.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Order placed a couple of days before…
review: Order placed a couple of days before Christmas, arrived on time and Jacub the delivery man was helpful.The quality of the products received are great and they were very reasonably priced.I have used Garden Bird on at least 3 occasions and will use them again.

title: Speedy delivery…
review: Ordered sunflower hearts and a mealworm feeder early one morning and received less than two days later.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Fast and affordabble…
review: My order was fulfilled and delivered within 2-3 days. As always GardenBird offer  reliable service and affordable prices. My box of bird food was left in a convenient place without any hassle by the delivery driver.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: The Birds Love the Stuff
review: A good range of products to choose from, competitive prices and quick delivery. The driver kindly put the 25kg package straight into the garage.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Order with ease and delivery will be quick
review: ordering was easy,there was good swift communication from the delivery company and my order arrived exactly as advised and within the time slot. The parcel was well packed and the plastic article inside was extremely well packaged.  A very good service !

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Packaging issues
review: The quality of your bird food is very good - however the packaging of your suet pellets could be better!I suggest that stronger plastic bags could be used to prevent spillages when transferring the pellets from the cardboard boxes to the storage bins. On 2 occasions the bags have split when lifted from the boxes resulted in a cascade of suet hitting the deck!

title: All goods were received in good condition
review: All the goods ordered were received in good condition and within the specified time scale. The only problem I had was that the courier separated the order of two packages and created two separate deliveries. One was late morning, and the second was very late afternoon/early evening. Ruined the whole day.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Double delivery..
review: Promp delivery but over two days. the supposed second delivery at 1700hrs. on the first day did not happen but was delivered the next day...

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Happy with product but not delivery !!
review: Very happy with the product & prices & the speed in which order delivered. Not happy with delivery drivers who continually ignore my ‘safe place’ & leave the boxes outside which means that if it rains the boxes etc get wet. On my last delivery I saw the driver & showed him exactly where the ‘safe place ‘ was. Basically they are too lazy or in too much of a hurry to just take a couple more minutes to put the parcels under cover.I have reported this before & nothing changes.Is there any point in  doing these reviews if no action is taken !!!!!

The birds seem very happy with my choice of food for them and everything gets eaten from the square suet blocks to the different seed mixes.Sometimes the packing isn't as could as it could be,  with heavy items being put on top of breakable and sometimes things might get squashed.  I had one delivery go missing but it arrived a while later,  not sure what happened. description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Service great. Containers not so
review: Service, price and delivery excellent but the containers really weren't as I had hoped. I had hoped that they would remain safely closed when filling the feeders. So I have made my own scoops from narrow drink bottles and that fixed the problem.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: I buy from Garden Bird on a regular…
review: I buy from Garden Bird on a regular basis and always choose leave safe delivery because I’m disabled with spinal issues and we both work full time hours. On this occasion the two extremely heavy boxes were just dumped at my front door instead of where they usually leave them stored safely. So when I got home from work I had to shuffle the boxes inside the house and I hurt my back. So the 3 rating is purely based on the actual delivery from DPD. Garden bird as a company are amazing and I will continue to use them every month or so to keep my local blackbirds fed with suet ☺️

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Too much transit to suet products
review: The prices are comparable with competitors. Delivery service fast and professional. There is too much damage to products caused by packing/transit. It's always been a problem, but it's been made worse by the 'environment friendly' packing. Plastic bags are better than paper for me! When I order suet fat balls and sprinkles, I don't want be dumping a large proportions that have been turned into granules/powder. The nuts and seeds are fine.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Goods excellent as usual
review: Goods as always very good. However ONCE AGAIN parcel left in porch not in my registered safe place. Parcel far too heavy for me to carry through the house. Garden bird excellent. Delivery company do not follow instructions.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Would have been five stars
review: Would have been five stars, but the price manipulation should not be legal. They offer constant discounts, but put the price up so you are still paying the standard price. Other than that, good quality product and quick delivery.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Good products
review: I buy most of my bird food from this Company and the quality is excellent. But the website can be clunky this time the discount code did not work though GB did refund me the amount without quibble I also had qualified for next day delivery but it was several days before it came

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Minimax problem but reliable company
review: Service is very good. I would give five stars. However... I am disappointed with the MiniMax pellets which I ordered.  I substituted them for the normal mealworm pellets I normally get from Garden Bird, but my regular garden bird visitors, as well as the three resident squirrels, absolutely refused them. One of the squirrels dumped them out of the feeder. All were left  behind. Clearly unappetising and not considered as edible by our wildlife.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Generally a happy customer
review: I have bought from Garden Bird and its sibling companies for a number of years. The birdfood is the cheapest I have found and the top of their rage food is as good as anywhere else (although I have known birds sneer at the cheaper fat products).The latest order was delivered in two huge, heavy boxes - but one small feeder was forgotten.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Products and prices good but don’t…
review: Products and prices good but don’t think we should be charged for delivery as we live in mainland UK.We live in an IV area which is near Inverness but there is a direct route via the A9.Many other companies deliver to us with no additional charge.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Usual great delivery but the 'No Grow…
review: Usual great delivery but the 'No Grow No Wheat Seed Mix' leaves a great deal of mess now as not all of it is eaten, especially corn. This wasn't the case previously. I don't want to attract woodpigeon and rats so I'll need to find another supplier that provides a real 'no mess' mix.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Disappointing
review: Good price for black sunflower seed, but arrived with both sacks split and seed leaking from the box. Prompt response to my complaint email, and two sacks received to transfer seed for storage. No compensation for lost seed (small amount) or inconvenience.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Paid extra for plastic tub of suet…
review: Paid extra for plastic tub of suet balls (as we'd had issues with rats) and it arrived broken. Emailed to request a replacement. Received no reply, just a £2 credit. Disappointing customer service. Don't care about the £2, will just order from RSPB next time.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.

The offered price was £26.99 each with a code as a first time customer offering a 20% discount with code GWGB20 (expiry 30/5/2023).  When contacting gardenbird the price was £29.49 (which they did offering to manually adjust to meet the £26.99) but could only offer 10% discount. They could not match the price they promised in the magazine - wasted my time.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.

review: The bird food is excellent but the courier just drops itover the gate and the packaging splits open. I need the product to be placed on the doorstep out of the rain.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.

review: First time using Garden Bird and was disappointed in the quality of the seed mix, there was lots of husk and dust in it. For the price I was expecting better as in the past I've bought seed from various retailers alot cheaper but better quality.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.

When it arrived, it had already been dropped a few times and was burst open. The 2x12.5k bags are good and successfuly prevented any wastage, but the outer packaging is inadequate - it needs better "handholds" for the van drivers.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Delivery error

After several days the gardener from an empty house called “Waterfront”, locally, brought the parcel to me as the proper address was on the label. During the interim period there was lots of rain so of course the packing was wet. The contents were OK though.Garden bird did their job OK but Evri let them down.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Don’t buy the ‘No Grow No Mess Seed Mix’
review: Disappointingly the birds have absolutely zero interest in eating the ‘No Grow No Mess Seed Mix’. Not sure why! Also, one day after ordering a 2kg bag ‘Croston Premium Wild Bird Mix’ there was an offer for a free 2kg bag of the mix, which was significantly better value that the 10% offer I received. It made me feel like I was being penalised despite my loyalty. Seriously considering shopping elsewhere for my bird supplies

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: 25 Kg package delivered to wrong address 100yds away. address in…
review: 25 Kg package delivered to address in street 100 yds away necessitating myself, 70 yrs old, with osteoarthritis in both hands to cut open the package and take two halves the 100 yds to my home, my hands were agony afterwards. How they delivered the previous time no bother but not this time amazes me. They have lost a potential long term customer, however I doubt they will read this. ,

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Overall disappointed
review: Overall disappointed. The delivery was quick. Unfortunately the bag of sunflower hearts was split and some of the contents were spread over the box. I don’t think too much was lost. Most disappointing though was the fact that I immediately contacted customer service, included photos, and have had absolutely no response at all. For this reason I shall probably not use this company again.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Delivery was promised but never…
review: Delivery was promised but never arrived. Had to chase the delivery company only to find they couldn't find the house even though they deliver almost every month. The redelivery then had to be delayed to avoid delivery while we were away. The delivery is scheduled for next week so hopefully it will arrive this time.

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Whilst there was nothing wrong with the…
review: Whilst there was nothing wrong with the product - they need to get a new delivery company! My order was left up the road in somebody's garage!  I got an email saying  my order had been delivered (and I hadn't got it) so I had to go walkabout to see if I could find it - maybe the delivery driver should try looking at the numbers on doors!

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.
title: Poor quality
review: The peanuts received in my last order are very small rubbish & fall through usual feeders. I no longer order fat balls from you since for some time they have also been poor. They dissolve in the rain ... perhaps an excess of bulking contents & little fat?

description: GardenBird offer the widest range of bird food & accessories online, including our unique range seed mixes.

title: Purchased for two mature whippets
review: Purchased for two mature whippets. Service is first class...response to email  swift, thank you. The quality of design, fabric and stitching for the beds is very good. My 4 star rating purely reflects the filling for the bed inner. Recommendation to remove unwanted excess filling appreciated as the filling is very generous. However, the fluffy type of stuffing provided takes too much time to 'bed in' for a dog. If too little is left in, the bed serves no purpose, but too much and the bed entrance becomes limited, unstable and uninviting for the dogs to enter. Dogs do not like unstable conditions. They prefer a soft, but stable environment to settle into. The beds would benefit from a more compact stuffing; this would create a better, more stable base which in turn would be more inviting for dogs to  bed down on. I have removed the filling provided and replaced it with feather cushions which is far better. Result...two happy whippets! On the down side is the expense for two beds!

title: I would not recommend!!!
review: I recently purchased the luxury deluxe cocoon cave bed for my dog, it was his birthday present. The bed arrived around a week before the birthday which was great, however, on unpacking on the day there was no instructions of how to put the bed together. Inside was this large piece of felt, a bendy rod and the curtains. I didn’t pay near £200 for a bed ‘I’ would have to put together!!!  As someone who suffers from a Mental Health condition I struggled terribly with trying to put it together and this impacted on my anxiety. In the end I gave up and first rang the moblie number on their website which was switched off or not available, can’t remember which but needless to say it didn’t connect and no facility to leave a message. I then completed the online form stating I was struggling to put the bed together due to my MH and could they send me instructions? That was on 15th Oct and to date I have heard nothing back. In the end I struggled through but the felt piece does not sit flush with the hood part of the cave bed and there are kinks in it where it folds due to excessive material. Whilst the bed is lovely the whole structure isn’t. The curtains keep sliding off as my dog gets in and out of his bed as they are not fixed or zipped to the main structure. The hood keeps collapsing because it’s not sturdy enough, it’s basically a piece of felt shoved in an empty space acting as a hood. Honestly I wish I’d not bought the bed and I wish I’d not bought it from this company, given the cost of it. It’s a useless bed for £194.97 and their aftercare is even worse! If you have MH or if you may need aftercare help then please go elsewhere for your dog bed because they have no active phone number where you can contact them if there is a problem, they don’t respond when you fill their contact form and the bed isn’t fit for purpose!
